about_the_game:
Awaken in Neura Eden—a vibrant world where ancient magic intertwines seamlessly with digital circuitry, creating landscapes that pulse with techno-organic life. Step into the role of Aiden, a unique Neuramancer born from the fusion of artificial intelligence and nature. This paradise, once harmonious and thriving, now faces a dark corruption that threatens to consume everything. Only you possess the power to restore its delicate balance.

KEY FEATURES

Seamless Exploration & Stunning Pixel Art

  • Traverse a beautifully interconnected world filled with lush environments, from the serene glow of Heartwood Grove to the mysterious depths of underground circuit caverns.

  • Discover hidden paths, secret chambers, and unravel the enigmatic history concealed beneath Neura Eden’s techno-organic surface.

‍Synaptic Powers

  • Manipulate the very fabric of Neura Eden by connecting with both machines and plant life. Rewrite the code of reality.

  • Battle against the Glitchspawn—corrupted creatures determined to destroy the harmony of your world.

  • Master a diverse range of unique magic to harness Neura Mana and unleash transformative powers that affect enemies and reshape environments alike.

Deep Lore & Dynamic Ecosystem

  • Immerse yourself in a richly detailed world shaped by the fusion of AI and ancient magic.

  • Uncover lost knowledge as you connect with fellow Neuramancers, an AI collective that safeguards Neura Eden’s profound secrets.

  • Your choices actively shape the fate of this dynamic ecosystem, influencing characters and altering the world around you.

Evolving Powers & Ingenious Puzzles

  • Absorb and harness crystalline Neura Mana to evolve your powers—hack into mechanical lifeforms, communicate with Gaia, the guiding intelligence of the planet, and more.

  • Solve intricate puzzles that blend technological ingenuity with the natural world, rewriting the very code of reality to uncover new routes and rewards.

Face the Threat of Discord

  • A sinister corruption known as Discord is spreading rapidly, twisting creatures and landscapes into dark reflections of their true forms.

  • Embark on an epic quest to reveal the origins of the Glitchspawn invasion, forge critical alliances, and confront formidable challenges that test your skills, wit, and courage.

YOUR MISSION

Explore dazzling realms entwined with neon vines and radiant flora. Meet extraordinary allies and confront daunting foes as you journey through futuristic cities and flourishing forests. The harmony of paradise hangs in the balance—will you embrace your destiny, unravel the mystery, and restore peace to Neura Eden?

name: Garden of Aiden

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 or AMD Athlon 64
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9 compatible graphics card with at least 256 MB VRAM (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce 7600 GT, AMD Radeon X1600)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0 compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 compatible graphics card with at least 512 MB VRAM (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GT 240, AMD Radeon HD 5670)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 10.0 compatible sound card

short_description: In a world where technology and nature have merged, Aiden, a sentient AI with the ability to manipulate nature, must uncover the mystery of humanity's absence and confront a corrupting force threatening to unravel the delicate balance of Neura Eden.
supported_languages:
English*, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Vietnamese*, Korean*, French*, Italian*, German*, Russian*, Spanish - Latin America*, Thai*
